name: Joel Yancey
bio: a Representative from Kentucky; born in Albemarle County, Va., October 21, 1773; member of the Kentucky state house of representatives, 1809-1811; served in the Ketucky state senate 1816-1820 and 1824-1827; elected as a Jacksonian candidate to the Twentieth and to the succeeding Congress (March 4, 1827-March 3, 1831); chairman, Committee on Expenditures in the Post Office Department (Twenty-first Congress); unsuccessful candidate for reelection in 1830 to the Twenty-second Congress; died in Barren County, Ky., in April 1838; interment in that county.
